name: boost
title_zh: 复杂编码任务先跑验证再动手的守门员
tagline_zh: 遇到 /boost 或高难度编码题，它先拆解、再验证、后动手。不靠猜，每一步都有可复现的检查点，改完代码心里有底。
tagline_en: For /boost or hard coding tasks: it decomposes, verifies, then edits. No guessing—every step has reproducible.
desc_en: Use when /boost or solving complex verified coding tasks.
why_zh: 它把「复杂」拆成可验证的小步，先跑通再改码，避免大改后崩盘。机制上强制验证前置，比直接生成更稳。
why_en: It breaks complexity into verifiable steps, testing before editing—so you avoid big-bang rewrites. Built-in checkpoints beat.
limit_zh: 只覆盖编码验证类任务，不处理纯文案或设计。需要本地有可运行的测试环境或构建工具；产物到验证通过为止。
limit_en: Only for coding verification tasks, not prose/design. Needs a runnable local test/build env. Stops at verification—no deployment or tuning.
title_en: Complex coding tasks: verify before you edit
